name: manual_125ccc
claim: Windows LAN discovery must expand the interface prefix, not assume a /24. A /22 that contains both 192.168.8 and 192.168.9 is one subnet. The Mac endpoint is Ollama port 11434. Do not preserve a last-good Mac address as reachable after this run failed to contact it. A subnet scan that only probes LM Studio port 1234 cannot see a Mac whose Ollama port is the one that is open.

decisions.notes: Discovery kept the previous last-good address because netifaces was missing, the scan collapsed to one octet, and last-good was copied back with reachable true. The live Mac was another host on that same prefix, answering Ollama on port 11434.
